title: Agent snippet: dlog ai and JSON shape docs
lead:
`dlog ai` prints a short AGENTS.md snippet telling agents how to use dlog, and
every read command's JSON shape is documented.
findings_note: PROJECT.md v1 feature tier; Risks (adoption); acceptance (--json documented)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the user-facing README and the dogfood run.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Risks: agents only use dlog if the instruction is short and the commands are
cheap. Acceptance requires a documented, stable `--json` shape on every read
command.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: The `commands` module (snippet text) and the project's docs location; CLI tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `dlog ai` exits 0 and prints the snippet.
- The snippet names `check`, `ask`, `inbox` and `context`.
- A test asserts each read command's `--json` keys match the documented shape.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Write the snippet and the JSON shape docs. The snippet uses the working name;
the final name follows C14.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
